Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Lead HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMER region
The role entails

  • Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy
  • Interact closely with the Americas HR Manager and the Global Head of HR to create impact across all HR regions
  • Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture and engagement initiatives that drive a high performing team
  • Work with managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
  • Partner with the HRIS team to develop and refine operational processes for day to day HR administration
  • Coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues across multiple countries
  • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
  • Experience mentoring and developing others
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice to have skills
  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and databases
  • Professional HR certification(s)
  • Facilitation skills
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of Growth and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth U.S. brands. You’ll be responsible for owning campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, brand, and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.
This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.
Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Barcelona, Brazil, and Colombia.
 What you'll do:

  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.
  • Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.

  • Understand digital marketing best practices and readily contribute to overarching marketing strategies to ensure client success across the board - even if it's paid media adjacent or outside of channel control.

title: Microservices Engineer
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general selection track for teams that focus on back-end REST API microservices engineering in Go and Python. It covers all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are an outstanding engineer with crisp and well-articulated views on APIs, microservice design, engineering processes and DevOps. Our services need to scale to handle millions of Ubuntu clients, and collaboration across thousands of community members. As Ubuntu has been embraced by mainstream enterprise computing through the adoption of cloud and developer-centric tech strategy, the quality of these services has become more important to customers and users. We are growing our teams and aim to level up our insights on scalability, performance, resilience and DevOps practices. Key areas of interest for us are: API design, documentation, and governance; database performance design considerations; multi-region service delivery for resilience and performance; fuzzing and other proactive security analysis techniques; tracing and profiling for distributed systems insights; next-generation DevOps practices.

Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality, well-designed, and robust software that works at scale
  • Design APIs and software architecture for collegial review
  • Write tests that validate software behaviour
  • Build and maintain reliable, fault-tolerant applications and services
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality solutions to resolve them
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Discuss, contribute to, and collaborate across teams at Canonical
  • Work from home with global travel twice annually for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Proficiency in Python and / or Go
  • History of writing modern, maintainable software
  • Experience with relational and non-relational database systems
  • Continuous integration and continuous delivery experience
  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains
  • Experience with cross-compilation
  • Experience with hyperscale public clouds and / or private clouds
  • Experience with designing, building, and running distributed systems
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. description:
Você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? Aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de vendas . Buscamos pessoas que se desafiem a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa , bom de gente e bom de jogo .

Quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? Vem pra FARM!

  • Atendimento consultivo à cliente;
  • Ser guardiã da experiência em loja, propagando a cultura da marca;
  • Acompanhar de forma proativa toda a jornada do cliente na loja, desde a entrada até a saída, garantindo uma experiência de compra diferenciada;
  • Foco na fidelização e realização do pós-venda (através da ferramenta Dito), mantendo nossas clientes sempre apaixonadas;
  • Gerenciar suas próprias vendas e entregas, assegurando a eficiência;
  • Impulsionar as vendas digitais, promovendo o código de vendedora e utilizando redes sociais, com foco em criar engajamento e gerar encantamento em cada interação;
  • Manter o ambiente da loja organizado, seguindo os padrões de VM e produção de moda;
  • Realizar o registro das vendas de pagamento digital, através da ferramenta Somabox, garantindo uma experiência de pagamento ágil e segura;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, com um espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • Facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e “escutatória”;
  • Interesse por moda, tendências, boas conversas e paixão pelo que faz;
  • Domínio de ferramentas digitais e redes sociais, essenciais para uma marca que conecta o físico e o digital;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Flexibilidade de horário.

Quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • Para garantir o seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:

Wellhub (antigo Gympass);

Assistência médica e odontológica com coparticipação;

Zenklub (duas sessões gratuitas por mês para consultas com profissionais de saúde, incluindo psicólogos e nutricionistas);

Política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães, 20 dias para pais

  • Day off, para curtir o seu aniversário;
  • E a melhor parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo SOMA.

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

A nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. O que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

Em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. De Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. E seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

title: Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems
description:
Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems as a key delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers. You will manage projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.

The role entails

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects

What we are looking for in you

  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: MÉDICO ESF - AP 3.3 (Zona Norte)
description:
A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS).

Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião-dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Desejável experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Médico.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Ejemplos de éxito de los clientes incluyen IA, Blockchain, IoT, robótica avanzada y vehículos autónomos, donde Ubuntu es la plataforma de desarrollo preferida.

Canonical es rentable y está creciendo. Consideramos que nuestra organización de desarrollo de ventas es la mejor academia de ventas de tecnología del mercado y, como tal, seleccionamos candidatos excepcionales y ambiciosos para unirse a nuestro equipo. Disfrutarás de este papel si eres organizado, persistente, carismático y trabajador. Deberás estar interesado en la tecnología y sus implicaciones comerciales. En este puesto, colaborarás con un equipo regional de ventas y marketing, y tu objetivo principal es encontrar proyectos de clientes que se ajusten a nuestras líneas de productos y difundir el buen nombre de Canonical en múltiples industrias y geografías diferentes.
Haz clic AQUÍ para ver a nuestro equipo SDR discutir su papel en Canonical
Cómo será tu día

  • Manejar las consultas entrantes de los clientes a través de correo electrónico, teléfono y chat.
  • Ejecutar campañas salientes de ventas y marketing.
  • Viajar a eventos y conferencias en todo el mundo, presentar en stands e impulsar oportunidades de marketing y ventas cara a cara.
  • Colaborar entre múltiples equipos y partes interesadas de alto nivel para impulsar resultados.
  • Trabajar directamente con marketing en campañas.
  • Investigar información sobre clientes potenciales.
  • Generar un pipeline de varios millones
  • Identificar perspectivas y tendencias del mercado.
  • Ayudar a definir los procesos y políticas del equipo.
  • Servir de enlace con clientes nuevos y existentes, organizando y asistiendo a reuniones mientras mapea activamente cuentas para identificar nuevas oportunidades.
  • Crear, actualizar, mantener y fomentar con precisión clientes potenciales en oportunidades globales.
Lo que buscamos en ti
  • Excelentes resultados académicos en la escuela y la universidad.
  • Pasión por los negocios y la tecnología.
  • Compromiso con el aprendizaje y la mejora continua: curioso, flexible, científico.
  • Resolución creativa de problemas y colaboración entre equipos.
  • Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
  • Impulsado por resultados con un espíritu de superación
  • Persistencia y perseverancia
Que te ofrecemos
Tu salario base dependerá de varios factores, incluida su ubicación geográfica, nivel de experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Shape The Future of Global Health, from Vietnam. At Elfie, we’re not just building a health tracking mobile app. We’re changing how people manage their health worldwide.

We provide relocation support to Vietnam for expats, and a seat at the table of one of Asia’s most exciting mobile health-tech companies.

Curious to learn more about our team, culture, and what it's like to relocate to Vietnam? Click here to find out more on our careers page!

About The Role

The Product Manager will lead the design of engaging, science-backed health programs that users love and stick with. From daily wellness routines to disease-specific management plans, Elfie’s flexible program ecosystem supports people at every stage of their health journey- turning behavior change into lasting lifestyle habits.

What You’ll Get

  • Permanent Global Contract - With a competitive salary
  • Private Healthcare - From day one
  • Top-Tier Tech Setup - Brand new MacBook + full onboarding kit
  • Career Growth Framework - Clear, personalised, and fast-moving
  • 14 Days PTO + Public Holidays - Real time off
  • Hybrid Working - 3 days in the office per week
  • Refreshments - Free Lunch and Dinner every day for you to enjoy

What You’ll Do

Shape Elfie’s global mobile health app program strategy — Design and deliver impactful, science-backed wellness and disease management journeys that resonate across diverse regions.

  • Research health trends and user needs to inform program design and evolution
  • Translate clinical and behavioral science into intuitive, engaging user experiences
  • Collaborate with behavior scientists, health experts, and content teams to create habit-forming journeys
  • Own the development of program features and experiences from concept to launch and iteration
  • Define clear logic and ensure all programs align with clinical standards and mobile app tech capabilities
  • Analyze user data and feedback to optimize adherence, satisfaction, and outcomes
  • Continuously improve the structure, logic, and content delivery across programs
  • Ensure programs adapt to different user segments—from everyday wellness to condition-specific needs

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally with internal tooling or platform products.
  • 3+ years managing a B2C product at scale, with a monthly active user base of 500,000+
  • Proven ability to own product development end-to-end from research to launch and iteration

Domain and behavioral expertise

  • Experience designing for health, wellness, or habit-forming digital products (is a big plus)
  • Ability to translate scientific or clinical insights into intuitive, user-friendly experience
  • Prior experience in early-stage startups, with comfort navigating fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments

User-centered design and tools

  • Proficient in Figma for wireframing, journey mapping, and collaboration on UI/UX
  • Strong grasp of mobile UX best practices, particularly for behavior change and engagement

Data-driven product thinking

  • Skilled in using user data and feedback to inform product decisions and measure impact
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including engineers, designers, and subject matter experts

Communication and collaboration

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, for effective work with global stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and coordinate across teams to drive alignment and results

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Product, Business, Engineering, or Health Sciences) is a plus

Informações adicionais
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)
Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!
Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!
Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.
Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

Descrição :
Responsável por garantir o bom estado geral do paciente renal crônico em tratamento dialítico, colaborando na resolução de problemas psicológicos, trabalhando a autonomia e engajamento do paciente, respeitando sua individualidade.
Garantir a aderência do paciente renal ao tratamento dialítico, analisando e intervindo nas situações de não aderência, assim como nas situações de faltas às sessões de diálise.

  • O que você irá realizar
  • Entrevistar os pacientes novos na unidade, registrando os dados no prontuário do paciente ou meio eletrônico (somente serão registradas informações que tenham relevância ao tratamento dialítico);
  • Acompanhar o estado psicológico do paciente através de atendimento aos pacientes em diálise periodicamente, avaliando a pertinência de intervenções específicas e assistindo individualmente aqueles que necessitem;
  • Favorecer um ambiente adequado de diálise, a fim de propiciar a aderência do paciente ao tratamento, tornando o tempo de diálise em momento produtivo;
  • Trabalhar visando à integração entre pacientes;
  • Orientar os pacientes e familiares proporcionando o acesso envolvimento ao seu tratamento, por meio da educação continuada e juntamente equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Promover a integração da equipe multidisciplinar x pacientes e um apoio para as dificuldades encontradas no lidar com o paciente renal crônico através da realização de reuniões com a equipe de saúde;
  • Promover reuniões periódicas com pacientes, objetivando esclarecer dúvidas e orienta-los quanto às implicações emocionais e comportamentais no tratamento dialítico;
  • Analisar mensalmente relatórios de faltas de pacientes as sessões de diálise e realizar plano de ação visando melhorar a aderência do paciente renal a sessão;
  • Solicitar a presença de pacientes/familiares em eventos sociais auxiliando na promoção destes eventos juntamente com serviço Social;
  • Representar a ouvidoria do paciente junto à Unidade de Diálise e encaminhar reclamações/solicitações pertinentes aos setores competentes;
  • Garantir o registro das informações psicológicas do paciente através da confecção das evoluções periódicas no prontuário do paciente ou me meio eletrônico;
  • Participar de processos institucionais, programas e/ou projetos corporativos estabelecendo um relacionamento adequado com os clientes externos e internos;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões técnicas, administrativas e multidisciplinares (Reuniões de Qualidade, PCPIEA, etc) da unidade visando melhoria continua dos resultados da unidade;
  • Participar de reuniões e resultados clínicos da unidade, visando à elaboração de plano de ação para situações (Relatório de faltas às sessões, problemas relacionados à não aderência, e outros);
  • Garantir a autorização para atuar na empresa através do cumprimento das obrigações legais mediante ao Conselho Regional de Psicologia assim como cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética e atendimento aos requisitos legais.
  • Esperamos que você tenha
  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia;
  • CRP ativo e regular;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento clínico em Nefrologia;
  • Desejável especialização em Psicologia Clínica;
  • Disponibilidade para cumprir 30 horas semanais e/ou 44 horas semanais
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro
  • Oferecemos: Salário e Benefícios compatíveis ao mercado.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Staff, NetSuite Consultant (Remote) role at Bryant Park Consulting .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About Bryant Park Consulting

Bryant Park Consulting is a leading Oracle | NetSuite consulting firm dedicated to helping businesses achieve their goals through successful ERP implementations and optimizations. We are a team of experienced consultants passionate about delivering exceptional client service and driving digital transformation. At Bryant Park Consulting, we foster a collaborative and supportive environment where our employees can thrive and grow professionally.

What you will do

As a Staff Consultant with Bryant Park Consulting you will be responsible for serving as lead consultant on end-to-end implementations of NetSuite for our Clients. Client stakeholders and other consultants on the team will look up to you for business process and systems architecture advisory based on your extensive NetSuite and business transformation experience.

  • Be proactive and serve as the Client's advocate during engagements
  • Participate in discovery and requirements gathering workshop
  • Participate in process mapping/reengineering and future state process design
  • Advise client on standard functionality, leading practices for software and industry
  • Functional system configuration design, drafting requirements and design documents
  • Collaborate with technical counterparts to deliver custom solutions to meet Client requirements
  • Manage scope and requirements and work within budget/allocation at all times
  • Lead Configuration Workshops and Offline Configuration Activities
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Systems Interface Testing (SIT) Activities
  • Lead End User Training (EUT) and enablement planning activities
  • Define data migration strategy and lead and/or complete all data migration activities
  • Provide ongoing support to Clients post go-live as needed
  • Participate in full-cycle NetSuite implementation projects, including all project phases: Plan, Design, Build, Verify, Deploy, Support
  • Translate complex business requirements and processes into technical designs
  • Perform fit/gap analysis on business requirements en route to system design and execution
  • Collaborate and work closely with in-house development team to implement custom solutions
  • Develop wireframe and schematic diagrams to support customer requirements gathering and overall business process discovery
  • Participate in project management activities such as status meetings, planning, work breakdown, and change control
  • Support efforts to attract new clients into the firm and with scoping new projects
  • Contribute to internal company initiatives including go-to-market efforts, knowledge management, and enablement
  • Willingness to learn and develop NetSuite product skills in all areas as required by customer engagement

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Advanced degree in Business, Accounting, Computer Science, or Information Systems
  • Ability to work efficiently and effectively in a virtual environment
  • 2-3+ years of hands-on NetSuite configuration and consulting/administration experience, 5+ full life cycle implementations
  • NetSuite Certifications heavily preferred - ERP Consultant, Administrator
  • Strong interpersonal communication, conflict resolution, and change management skills
  • Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment
  • Ability to successfully manage client and team interactions, and communicate with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong background in finance/accounting, supply chain, consulting services, and/or industry specific experience
  • Capable of designing end-to-end solutions with SuiteCloud Platform tools (SuiteBuilder, SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, SuiteTalk)
  • Extensive familiarity with data migration plan and procedures and hands-on experience completing Go-Live cutover data loads
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

Work From Home & Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to be on-site with clients as needed (note: this role is fully remote)

Salary Range

$205,000 to $275,000 BRZ

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the approximate annual base compensation range is listed above. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package and benefits, will be determined by a number of factors including the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.

Putting Our People First From Day One

From the founding of Bryant Park Consulting, we committed to putting people first and offering variety, fulfillment, and balance. You will have the opportunity to work with the world's top companies and business leaders, keep up with the latest technology, and flex your skills across industries and disciplines. You will also be encouraged to engage with your community and nature. We attract and retain the best in the business - people from industry, consulting, agencies, startups, nonprofits, and the public sector - all drawn to building a career that's both exciting and sustainable.

  • Feed Your Curiosity - Foster technical and industry expertise, and grow as a leader. Knowledge management and professional development are held in highest regard, we offer and sponsor flexible learning options on topics from Project Management to Web Development, and we pay for certifications with top programs.
  • Cultivate Well Being - Thrive holistically with a robust and personalized set of benefits and company resources to support your emotional, mental, financial, physical, and social well-being. Celebrate with your team or explore interests with other team members, from book clubs to speaking events and annual retreats.
  • Choose Your Career - There is no pressure to go 'up-or-out' and welcome you to build a career that gets you excited about coming to work every day - whether that's as an individual contributor or a team manager. Performance is evaluated fairly and regularly and as the organization grows we expect you and your career to grow with us.
  • Comprehensive Benefits - We provide best-in-class benefits for employees including 401k with Company match up to 6%, United Health Plan, as well as Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment, and more. We also encourage and reimburse for costs of approved training, continuing education, skills development, and professional certification programs and exams to help further your career development.

Bryant Park Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Localização & Trabalho Remoto

Nosso time de For Rental Business Operations trabalha no modelo "remote-first", o que significa que estamos trabalhando de casa com a possibilidade de morar em qualquer lugar do Brasil. Também temos a opção de utilizar os escritórios em São Paulo ou utilizar os espaços de coworking de parceiros, ambos até duas vezes por semana.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

As etapas dos nossos processos seletivos têm como objetivo avaliar suas experiências e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e oportunidades de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

  • Case de negócio
  • Entrevista com Hiring Manager

Sobre a Área

City Growth Roadmap (CGRM) é a frente responsável pela expansão do nosso negócio de aluguel em cidades onde ainda temos baixo market share. Nosso objetivo é destravar crescimento de forma acelerada, testando e escalando alavancas que maximizem a geração de oferta (Supply).

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be part of an amazing global team that operates in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. You will work with 1000+ teammates from 30+ nationalities and develop an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders who take on challenges, are customer-centric, and we believe you will thrive in our team if this sounds like you.

Opportunity

We are building dLocal’s crypto rails — from off-ramps to stablecoin payouts and settlements. We need someone hands-on to run the day-to-day operations that make these flows work. This role is execution-first: setting up processes, managing integrations, tracking issues, and ensuring our merchants and partners get a smooth experience.

What will I be doing?

  • Own the operational rollout of new crypto flows (off-ramp, payouts, settlements, on-ramp)
  • Manage daily operations with partners (wallets, custodians, processors) including reconciliations, settlements, and troubleshooting
  • Track and escalate technical or operational issues; work with Product/Tech teams on fixes
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, regulatory requirements, and risk frameworks across all crypto processes
  • Build and maintain detailed process documentation and runbooks for scale
  • Support internal teams (Commercial, Finance, Treasury, Compliance) with timely operational insights

What skills do I need?

  • 2–4 years of experience in fintech, payments, or crypto operations
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills; detail orientation is a must
  • Experience managing flows such as settlements, reconciliations, or payment processing
  • Comfortable working with APIs, dashboards, and transaction data (not engineering, but operationally fluent)
  • Able to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • Office attendance requirement for Montevideo-based non-IT roles

Application process

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so you will hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process. You can also check out our webpage, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube for more about dLocal.

TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE, PLEASE SUBMIT AN UPDATED RESUME TRANSLATED TO ENGLISH
 Who is Housecall Pro?
Housecall Pro is a fintech company founded in 2013. We built a SaaS platform that helps Home Service Professionals operate their businesses. We created the application for plumbers, electricians, and other Pros in the home improvement/trades industries.
Housecall Pro is a simple, cloud-based field service management software platform aimed at helping companies keep track of jobs, monitor technician activity, and produce invoices easily .
Our core product helps our clients with scheduling, dispatching, job management, invoicing, payment processing, marketing, and more. They used to struggle with the ton of paperwork after their hours. Now they can save time, and manage their business in one app.
We support more than 27,000 businesses and have over 1,300 ambitious, mission-driven employees in San Diego, Denver, and all over the world (including 200+ talented and innovative Engineers).
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?:

  • Remote environment totally built to make you feel that we are all together in one space without leaving your home office!
  • Self Managed PTO - Beach? Mountains? Camping? Discovering new experiences? You are free to take time out as you need!
  • Flexible work hours - We believe that you can reach your professional and personal goals working with us and encourage you to have a work life balance!
  • A culture built on innovation that values big ideas - We are always open to new ideas that will improve the life of our Pros!
  • Work in your own time zone - Because we don’t think that you should miss those memorable moments with your friends and family!
  • Newest MacBook (or PC if you prefer!) + Setup Fee ($500) - What is an engineer without the right tools right? Here in HCP, you can choose your computer and set up your home office!
We know what you are thinking…WHAT IS THE ROLE AND WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?
As Ruby on Rails Architect, you are a critical individual contributor and architectural leader within our engineering organization. You drive the long-term technical vision of our platform, guiding how we design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable systems across multiple squads. As a high-impact, high-autonomy technical leader, you combine deep technical contributions with influential cross-team collaboration, helping shape the future of our platform to better serve our customers.
You serve as a trusted technical partner to Engineering Managers, Directors, and Product leadership, taking ownership of our most complex technical challenges while mentoring engineers across the organization. You play a pivotal role in our transition from a monolithic Ruby on Rails application toward a modern, distributed, event-driven, domain-oriented architecture.
Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Our success is their success.
In Your Daily Routine, You Will
  • Lead cross-squad architecture efforts, shaping and evolving technical direction across multiple domains
  • Design and build scalable, fault-tolerant systems to ensure outstanding performance and reliability as our customer base grows
  • Champion Domain-Driven Design (DDD) practices and empower teams to structure software around clear, maintainable domain boundaries
  • Advocate for and guide the adoption of event-driven system design using tools such as Kafka and SQS
  • Educate and mentor engineers on architecture principles, design patterns, and best practices across the engineering organization
  • Identify and drive the resolution of technical bottlenecks and hotspots through refactoring and re-architecture efforts
  • Uphold and advance engineering excellence in areas such as performance optimization, secure coding, test automation, and CI/CD health
  • Conduct deep technical reviews of codebases and architectural designs to ensure long-term maintainability and scalability
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to align technical solutions with business needs
  • Model a culture of ownership, accountability, and technical excellence across squads
  • Help engineers leverage AI to boost productivity and solve complex product challenges through hands-on guidance and enablement.
You must be aware that joining Housecall Pro means:
  • Building a product that really improves users’ lives (70k users, 4.6 rates at App Store) - let’s see what clients say about the product;
  • Being a part of a global team that build a diverse culture in our company
  • Working with more than 200 engineers highly qualified and engaged in improving the life of our Pros.
  • Having a real impact on technical decisions without breaking through the corporate, glass ceiling;
  • Being in direct contact with the community of users, who are eager to share their feedback;
  • Rapidly growing teams that create a defined career path.
We think that this offer is for you if you have:
  • 9+ years of experience designing, building, and operating complex production systems
  • Deep experience in Ruby/RoR
  • Proficiency in multiple programming languages (i.e. JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, Node.js)
  • Deep expertise with cloud platforms (i.e. AWS), containerization, and serverless/cloud-native architectures
  • Proven success applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles across multiple teams or domains
  • Experience architecting and building event-driven systems using distributed messaging tools (i.e. Kafka, SQS)
  • Experience with defining and improving CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Gitlab, etc) and automated testing strategies (e.g., e2e, canary tests, integration tests, etc)
  • Expertise in scalable API design and management (i.e. RESTful APIs; GraphQL is a plus)
  • Strong background in system observability practices (logs, metrics, tracing) and performance diagnostics
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
And Also, You Get Extra Points For
  • Strong systems thinking with an ability to simplify complex problems
  • Comfort working through ambiguity and making well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information
  • Collaborative nature with a proactive approach to communicating technical trade-offs
  • Deep empathy for the end-user and a commitment to building solutions that deliver real value
  • Ownership mentality with a balance of urgency and long-term system health
  • Curiosity and passion for staying current on evolving architecture patterns and best practices
  • Demonstrate a strong passion for using AI technologies to enhance productivity, quality, and innovation
  • Curiosity and drive to stay ahead of emerging AI/ML technologies and their practical applications
Okay, okay, you need something to pay the bills, right?
Our range of compensation starts at: 8000 USD dollars.
Come and join us in HCP!
Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.
Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.
We support more than 40,000 businesses and have over 1,800 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you

title: MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (OFTALMOPEDIATRA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ
description:
Join to apply for the MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (OFTALMOPEDIATRA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Join to apply for the MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (OFTALMOPEDIATRA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. Uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.
A unidade de saúde está preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia;
Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;
Especialista em Oftalmopediatria com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.
Informações adicionais
  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais
  • Regime de contratação CLT
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)
description:
Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

We're looking for a highly motivated team player to join our hungry squad as a Brand & Marketing Designer.

Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome) with compensation set based on agreed hours/work scope of part-time role (flexible).

  • Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact
  • Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design

About The Opportunity

We're building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a 'make it pretty' gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

What You'll Do

You'll partner with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Founders to:

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets)
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers)
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve

What Success Looks Like

Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS

  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework

Who You Are

6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house). You know the category patterns - and how to break them. Exceptional taste. Refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.

Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you've got references at your fingertips. Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.

Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply. Tools: Figma & Wordpress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.

Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports). Bonus Points if You...

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling)
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops)
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first)
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing

To apply, please include:

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work)
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal → your role → outcome (metrics if possible)
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets)
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project

Email your application to ******. Important: Share your LinkedIn and portfolio.

Feita de pessoas que transformam a educação

Vaga remota

Descrição Da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Gestão de Acessos para atuar na liderança da equipe de Governança de Segurança da Informação da Arco.

Quais serão os seus desafios

  • Gerenciar Equipe De Gestão De Acessos : Coordenar analistas e técnicos responsáveis por provisionamento, revisão e auditoria de acessos.
  • Estabelecer e Manter Políticas De Controle De Acesso : Garantir conformidade com normas internas (ex: políticas de segurança da informação) e externas (ex: LGPD, SOX, ISO 27001).
  • Garantir Segregação De Funções (SoD) : Evitar conflitos de interesses em sistemas críticos (ex: financeiro, ERP, RH).
  • Aprovar e Revisar Acessos Periodicamente : Coordenar campanhas de revisão de acessos com gestores e áreas de compliance.
  • Automatização e Melhoria Contínua : Implementar soluções de IAM (Identity & Access Management) e automações com foco em eficiência e redução de riscos.
  • Suporte a Auditorias Internas e Externas : Fornecer evidências, relatórios e justificativas relacionadas ao controle de acessos.

Buscamos Talentos Que Tenham

  • Requisitos Obrigatórios : Formação superior completa em áreas como Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação, Sistemas de Informação ou afins.
  • Experiência sólida com gestão de acessos e identidade: Provisão e desprovisão de usuários, matrizes de acesso, SoD, RBAC (Role-Based Access Control).
  • Conhecimento De Ferramentas De IAM/Gestão De Acessos : Ex: SailPoint, Oracle IAM, CyberArk, Azure AD, Okta, SAP GRC, etc.
  • Experiência Com Auditorias e Conformidade : Ex: SOX, ISO 27001, LGPD, GDPR.
  • Capacidade de liderança e gestão de equipe.
  • Conhecimento em processos ITIL.

Certificações

  • Requisitos Desejáveis : Ex: CISM, CISSP, ITIL, COBIT, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.
  • Experiência Com Ferramentas De ITSM : Ex: ServiceNow, Jira, Remedy.
  • Inglês Intermediário/avançado : Para atuar em empresas multinacionais ou lidar com ferramentas/documentações em inglês.
  • Conhecimento em projetos de governança de identidade (IGA).
  • Familiaridade Com Ambientes Em Nuvem : Ex: Azure AD, AWS IAM, Google Workspace Admin.
  • Habilidades em análise de dados e geração de relatórios: Uso de Excel avançado, Power BI, ou SQL para extração e análise de dados de acesso.

A Arco acredita que o valor está nas pessoas , e uma das nossas formas de demonstrar isso no dia a dia é por meio das nossas ações de bem-estar e cuidados com nosso time.

A LWSA é a união de diversas empresas que oferecem as mais diferentes soluções, mas que se complementam, com um único objetivo: ajudar negócios a nascerem e prosperarem por meio da tecnologia .

A LWSA, que antes se chamava Locaweb, adotou o seu nome atual. Hoje tem inúmeras marcas em um ecossistema que oferece serviços para todos os tamanhos de negócio. Isso inclui os serviços de plataforma de e-commerce, ERP, integração com marketplace, PDV, recorrência, geração de leads, crédito & logística, entre outros.

Conheça um pouco da área para esta oportunidade: o time de Produtividade é responsável pela gestão de aplicações que habilitam PMEs de todo o Brasil a operar seus negócios com alta eficiência.

Para esta oportunidade, buscamos pessoas que sejam curiosas, entusiastas de tecnologia e tenham sólida experiência como PO ou PM.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Product discovery: Sequenciar features em cada release, desdobrando-as em Épicos e Histórias de Usuário e documentar fluxos do serviço e regras de negócio definidas para a solução.
  • Upstream: Garantir que o backlog esteja preparado antecipadamente, atualizado, priorizado e refletindo as decisões estratégicas do produto; classificar tarefas com base no impacto, esforço e dependências; descartar tarefas com baixo valor ao negócio e reportar o motivo do descarte; criar e detalhar histórias de usuário, requisitos funcionais, critérios de aceitação e casos de teste; garantir clareza das histórias para o time e refletir necessidades dos usuários e do negócio; definir e validar critérios de aceitação.
  • Downstream: Colaborar ativamente com o time de engenharia em cadências e canais para esclarecer dúvidas; homologar funcionalmente as entregas; acompanhar itens de trabalho de outros times que afetam o produto; documentar atas e acordos decorrentes dos refinamentos e interações com time de engenharia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em gestão de produtos digitais.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de produtos utilizando processos e metodologias ágeis, sobretudo Scrum e Kanban.
  • Domínio de escrita de User Stories, condução de refinamentos, gestão de backlog, Roadmap e definição de frameworks ou critérios de priorização.
  • Conhecimento da metodologia de OKRs para garantir que o time entregue resultados (outcome driven).
  • Capacidade de identificar problemas e hipóteses e conduzi-los desde product discovery até product delivery.
  • Visão holística sobre o produto e abordagem orientada a dados (data driven), considerando dados de diferentes áreas para a estratégia de produto.
  • Capacidade de conciliar problemas atuais com estratégia de longo prazo.
  • Conhecimento sobre ciclo de vida de produto.
  • Autonomia técnica de produto para lidar com cenários complexos e promover um ambiente de criação colaborativo com o time; não é necessário background técnico, mas é fundamental entender termos técnicos para comunicar-se com o time de desenvolvimento.

HR professional with 6+ years of experience in talent acquisition, process optimization, and recruitment strategy. Skilled in leadership, KPI…

We are seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Manager with a strong management background to oversee talent acquisition strategies, onboarding, and end-to-end recruitment processes. The ideal candidate will have at least 3-5 years of experience managing Talent Acquisition teams and a proven track record of managing the full-cycle recruitment process.

This is a management-level role focused on optimizing talent operations, ensuring alignment between offshore talent and internal hiring managers, and driving efficiency across recruitment workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Process Management : Work closely with hiring managers and HR teams to align on talent needs and hiring priorities. Address roadblocks to streamline the hiring process.
  • Project & Process Optimization : Lead initiatives to improve recruitment workflows, implement best practices, and track recruitment metrics.
  • Sourcing Strategy & Candidate Engagement : Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to build diverse talent pipelines. Proactively engage with potential candidates to build relationships.
  • Employer Branding & Candidate Experience : Contribute to employer branding initiatives to attract top talent. Ensure a positive and consistent candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Track and analyze key recruitment metrics to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and provide data-driven insights to stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Best Practices : Ensure all recruitment activities comply with legal and regulatory requirements and adhere to best practices.
  • Recruitment Technology & Tools : Leverage and optimize recruitment technologies (ATS, CRM, sourcing tools) to improve efficiency.

  • Talent Acquisition Experience : Minimum of 4 years of experience managing client facing processes and overseeing full-cycle recruitment.
  • Strong Communication & Stakeholder Management : Exceptional written and verbal English skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders and stakeholders across time zones.
  • Project Management & Process Optimization : Proficient with recruitment tools (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse, Lever) and project management software (e.g., Asana, Trello). Strong process improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

MÉDICO DE FAMÍLIA - AP 1.0 (Zona Central do Rio e Paquetá)

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS).

Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

Responsabilidades

  1. Realizar atendimentos médicos conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.
  2. Promover a saúde através de ações de prevenção e tratamento.
  3. Realizar diagnósticos e reabilitação de pacientes.
  4. Coordenar o cuidado e facilitar o acesso aos serviços de saúde.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Desejável experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Médico.

Local de trabalho: Região central do Rio de Janeiro.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Join to apply for the Data Engineer role at Ryz Labs .

Ryz Labs is looking for a Data Engineer to help enhance and stabilize the data monitoring system for one of our biggest clients. You will collaborate with the data engineering team to improve orchestration and monitoring using tools like Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and AWS services.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define SLAs and implement meaningful metrics for data health.

  • Experience creating and maintaining dbt models with test coverage and clear documentation.
  • Expertise in managing Airflow DAGs, handling retries, and structuring tasks for reliability and visibility; experience with Astronomer is a bonus.
  • Deep familiarity with AWS DMS, Kinesis, and Firehose, especially around monitoring and alerting integrations.
